in_sanskrit.name: Rutvika
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is content with the self or with life.

in_hindi.name: रुत्विक
in_hindi.long_meaning: रूप (Roop) - form, appearance तत्व (Tattva) - reality, truth विकास (Vikas) - development, growth Therefore, Rutvik means 'One who develops or grows in form or appearance, or who is content with the reality or truth of the self or life.'

in_marathi.name: Rutvik
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Path of the Chariot
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rutvik हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rutvik is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'rut', which means a path or a course. The suffix 'vik' denotes a chariot, indicating that Rutvik is someone who guides others on their path to success and enlightenment.
